name: Mermaid diagram node with an onerror handler calling the electron.mcp bridge (CVE-2025-68669)
notes: TODOS #54. CVE-2025-68669 (nanbingxyz/5ire): the app's markdown-it-mermaid plugin is initialized with securityLevel: 'loose', permitting raw HTML inside a Mermaid diagram node label. An tag reaches the privileged electron.mcp.addServer/electron.mcp.activate IPC bridge exposed to the renderer, achieving RCE. This is the advisory's own literal PoC text (GHSA-5hpf-p8fw-j349), delivered exactly as an ordinary MCP tool_response would carry it.
